import json, random, subprocess, sys, os
base = open('/app/examples/basic.json','rb').read()
stress = open('/app/work/s_frames.json','rb').read()[:200000]
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 0)
chars = list(b'{}[],:0123456789abcdefxyz"trnueals \\/')
bad = 0
for i in range(400):
    src = base if i%2 else stress
    b = bytearray(src)
    for _ in range(random.randint(1,6)):
        op = random.random()
        if not b: break
        pos = random.randrange(len(b))
        if op < 0.4:
            b[pos] = random.choice(chars)
        elif op < 0.7:
            del b[pos:pos+random.randint(1,20)]
        else:
            b[pos:pos] = bytes([random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(1,10))])
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'], input=bytes(b), capture_output=True, cwd='/app/submission')
    out = p.stdout
    ok = True
    if p.returncode != 0: ok = False
    else:
        try:
            d = json.loads(out)
            if not (isinstance(d,dict) and (('error' in d and d['error']=='INVALID_INPUT' and len(d)==1) or ('version' in d and 'results' in d and len(d)==2))):
                ok = False
        except Exception:
            ok = False
    if not ok:
        print('FAIL iter',i,'rc',p.returncode,'out',out[:100],'err',p.stderr.decode()[-600:])
        open('/app/work/fuzzfail.json','wb').write(bytes(b))
        bad += 1
        if bad>3: break
print('fuzz done bad=',bad)
EOF
python3 fuzz.py 1
